newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-St George warns against binge loans.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-St George warns against binge loans.

text.p: St George Bank Ltd chairman Frank Conroy on Wednesday warned that the local banking sector should resist the temptation to return to the big lending days of the 1980s.

"I think that there is a lot of care required in the market at the moment, because there are some very aggressive lenders out there, as I used to see back in the '80s," Conroy told Reuters after the regional bank's annual meeting.
"There only needs to be a turn the wrong way in the economy ...and then you find some people finding a higher interest rate bill and getting themselves into trouble," Conroy said.
